description: A non-integer whose mantissa needs all of 256 bits keeps its value
notes: The left operand is (2^256 - 1) / 4 = 2^254 - 0.25, whose mantissa is 256 one bits. With fewer bits it would round to 2^254, the right operand, and the comparison would be false. The values are compared rather than printed because their decimal forms are too long to compare portably.
